other_executed_controls.scope: Per-suite counts; the full-system checks are not additional Rust test cases. The captured middle-deletion control was repeated locally, not a second distinct attack.

observer_signature_recheck.anchor_provenance: Original public file from the GitHub artifact, supplied separately from signed archive records. Institutional approval of this anchor is not established.

captured_gateway_signature_recheck.reason: No independently supplied gateway public anchor was retained for the two captured stdio receipts. The actual gateway/library tests are separate evidence; no key was inferred from a receipt.

health_boundary.claim: All retained batch signatures and links verify. Latest health does not seal the last batch; no complete final-head coverage claim is inferred.

preservation.method: Exact public-file copies and gzip -n -c of the original batch, health and gateway-receipt streams. Decompression equality was checked against every original stream.
excluded: Raw collector, probe and attack logs

limits: This is a component rehearsal on one disposable GitHub-hosted Linux VM, not the genuine same-run banking AI workflow.
Separate processes sharing one root and kernel do not establish separate collector administration.
Acts 3 and 4 do not establish bank transaction settlement or a complete production MCP deployment.
Anchor-relative signature verification proves signed bytes and linkage; it does not make a compromised workload kernel truthful.
A valid prefix or suffix can still verify without an independently retained archive-boundary checkpoint.
Institutional anchor approval, clean-host customer installation and independent bank acceptance remain separate gates.
